priorApproximation: Joint Gaussian moment match on active preseason driver/previous-team strengths and age coefficients; age uncertainty propagated
limitations: All 20 currently available rounds have sequential forecasts.
Each forecast uses earlier race orders only, but its participant set is retrospectively conditioned on actual eligible finishers. Not a full-grid pre-race forecast.
Driver baseline, season form and team strength are inferred jointly; this is not isolated driving quality.
The historical prior is approximated by a joint Gaussian; age uncertainty is propagated through the sequential updates.
Reset/form/process settings are research choices. Historical backtests are encouraging but do not establish full-grid forecast calibration.
Model-derived ranges and descriptive tail frequencies are not calibrated confidence guarantees or p-values.
